name: 75390 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75390 (Dallas) has 11 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (73%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 75390 (Dallas) has 8 organizations listing opportunities in their tax returns or websites, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 9% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Where do people here come together, and who brings them together? Which of those places would not show up in nonprofit records?
